description: Runs the ROAS Expert product page check on one product URL and returns the score out of 100, the grade, the platform, category scores, the top three issues, the status of all 19 checks, a table of which questions a shopping assistant can answer from the page (price, stock, delivery, returns, variants, identity, ratings) and a shareable report link. The detail and the platform-specific fix for every failing or warning check are unlocked with the user's work email through unlock_report. Takes 5 to 15 seconds. Pass a product page URL; a homepage or other page gets a short note and does not count against the free limit, which is shared with audit_site.

url.description: Product page URL, for example https://store.com/products/example

name: audit_product_page
title: Audit one product page for AI shopping readiness
